why.german.title: Why a doctor from Germany?
why.german.body: German specialty training is among the most rigorous in the world. You get the same standard as a private patient in Frankfurt — in your language, from home.
testimonials.title: What patients say
testimonials.t1.body: I was scared to talk about my reflux. Dr. Al-Shdaifat listened in Arabic and explained calmly. I felt safe.
testimonials.t1.author: — Layla, 54, Amman
testimonials.t2.body: Diabetes plus stomach pain — my local doctor was rushed. The German consultation took its time and was thorough.
testimonials.t2.author: — Omar, 67, Irbid
testimonials.t3.body: Pregnant and afraid to take any medicine. The doctor walked me through everything in plain Arabic.
testimonials.t3.author: — Yasmeen, 32, Aqaba
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is this covered by my Jordanian insurance?
faq.a1: The first conversation is free. For follow-ups we share an invoice you can submit to your insurer.
faq.a2: Choose Arabic, German or English. The doctor speaks all three.
faq.a3: In Frankfurt, Germany — under both German and Jordanian privacy law. You can ask for a copy or for it to be deleted at any time.
voice.memo.hint: Many patients prefer Arabic voice. The doctor will listen and reply.
